report:
Reviewed the complete selected_semantics claim, its one ordinary implementation and all three test entries. Independently verified exact historical byte equality for tytree/mod.rs and all three test-source files by joining stored lines with newlines; this corroborates the supplied prior review but is not test execution.

ResolvedCallTarget explicitly retains function, dispatch, owner_type_args and method_type_args; CallDispatch distinguishes Direct and StaticTrait, with the latter storing self_ty and trait_ref. There is no mandatory concrete impl identity in this representation, satisfying the qualification that proof need not provide one. This is representation evidence, not a new audit of all call producers.

The ordinary clone test inspects a completed ResolvedCall, selected clone function and StaticTrait dispatch, named Clone trait, ADT Self, and equality between Self and the elaborated receiver field type. Its receiver assertions additionally establish the actual checked-call context. The ordinary operator test inspects selected add, owner substitutions Left and Right and output Sum for the captured Add<Right> for Left fixture; assert_symbol_name checks actual names and excludes unresolved use symbols. Its final empty-diagnostics assertion prevents the early diagnostic return from passing silently. Captured harness helpers invoke the body assertions with the constructed module/database (twice for the operator fixture). These assertions would catch wrong selected names, absent static dispatch, missing/wrong owner arguments or inconsistent receiver Self in their exercised cases.

The explicit todo::types_calls_selected_semantics entry remains justified: direct/static-trait substitution matrices and generic trait calls, particularly nonempty method substitutions, are not established by these nongeneric examples. Its prerequisite is adding those concrete call fixtures and checking owner/method substitutions and generic selected trait/Self data before treating the matrix as covered. The empty TODO body supplies no behavioral evidence. The existing representation and integration examples plus this explicit gap account for the full claim; no N/A or hidden claim of complete generic coverage is made.

Executed review start, review read and historical byte comparison, then review record. One initially out-of-bounds helper read was corrected to lines 731–735. No behavioral tests or build were run by this reviewer; the coordinator separately reports 321 sage-meta tests and cargo build passing. Accepted deferral remains TODO. No source edits or additional requested changes.
